panels.name: missing
panels.html:
Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

Meetings

Show "In a meeting" beside your name while your Google Calendar says you're busy. Connect Google Calendar first — only free/busy times are read, never titles or attendees.

Out of office

Show "Out of office" beside your name until the end you pick. It clears itself when the end passes, and wins over a custom status, DND, and the meeting label.

in your time zone

Use out-of-office events from your Google Calendar to mark yourself out automatically. Connect Google Calendar first — only the event type and times are read, never titles or details.

panels.html:
Status

Automatic shows you online while you're here and idle after 10 quiet minutes. Your custom status shows beside your name.

Meetings

Show "In a meeting" beside your name while your Google Calendar says you're busy. Only free/busy times are read — never titles or attendees. A custom status or DND shows instead.
